name: Summer Champs
blurb: Sprint, jump, swim and lift your way to ten gold medals!

background.css: linear-gradient(transparent 0 95%, #F2B705 95%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0 2px, transparent 2px 38px) top/100% 34% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle at 85% 12%, rgba(242,183,5,.28), transparent 45%), linear-gradient(#07122A, #0B1B3A)

source.notes: Title screen is Barlow Condensed 800 italic, as in the game logo in white on stadium navy #07122A with the gold #F2B705 accent bar. A gold track-edge bar at the bottom, faint lane lines up top and a gold glow by the medal echo the broadcast HUD and track. Blurb shortened from the Claude Design card.json to fit 2 lines.
